item: The YAML depth guard refuses a too-deep document with the same error on PyYAML 6.0.4, whose libyaml 0.2.6 raises its own nesting error first
summary: PyYAML 6.0.4 (PyPI 2026-11-20 23:34Z) bundles libyaml 0.2.6, whose scanner raises ScannerError 'exceeded maximum nesting depth' past 1,000 levels (measured: flow to 1,000, raise at 1,001; block mappings raise at 1,000). Its read-ahead reaches that before the guard's event count reaches 256 on a deep flow document, so a hostile file read as a malformed one and every CI line installing 6.0.4 went red in 4 tests. safe_yaml now maps that error to YAMLDepthError in the pre-pass and the load, on any PyYAML; the pre-guard crash tests key on libyaml's version (crash below 0.2.6, raise from it). Engine pins kept with --same (identical rows, no re-index). Red before under 6.0.4: the 4 named tests and the new one.
